ladder_20seeds.new_concept: Agents now track 'surprise' — the difference between expected and observed outcomes
Agents value actions that reduce uncertainty, not just actions that yield reward
Agents maintain probabilistic beliefs about hidden project state (health, urgency) and update them via variational inference after each observation
Actions selected by minimizing Expected Free Energy: a single objective that naturally balances reward-seeking (pragmatic) and information-seeking (epistemic)
Agents accumulate Dirichlet concentration parameters for their policy prior (E-vector)
The precision parameter γ (inverse temperature) adapts over time
LLM participates as a probabilistic node in the factor graph
